input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) binds only us (Licensee) and runs for the Term plus three years post-termination, covering any person employed by Licensor or its Affiliates rather than only personnel involved in the engagement. A restriction longer than 24 months that covers all Licensor personnel is walk-away territory under the rule, so the clause fails the fallback on duration, scope and mutuality. On the positive side, "Solicit" is defined narrowly and already carves out general job advertising and voluntary/unsolicited inquiries, and there is no "no-hire" element, so only duration, scope and mutuality need fixing. Per the redline guidance we narrowed to the fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved, 12 months from the end of involvement) rather than deleting the covenant, retaining the existing carve-out sentence. Note the injunctive-relief clause (p0126) gives Licensor equitable relief for non-solicitation breaches, which magnifies the over-broad scope.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance or receipt of this Agreement to leave his or her employment with such other party; provided that this restriction shall in no event apply to any such person more than twelve (12) months after the end of that person's involvement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the non-solicit mutual and narrowed it to personnel directly involved in this Agreement for 12 months from the end of their involvement, consistent with our playbook position on restrictive covenants; a three-year restriction covering every Licensor and Affiliate employee is far broader than the engagement. The existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out is retained.
proposal.summary: Make non-solicit mutual, limit to personnel involved in the Agreement, and reduce duration from three years to 12 months.
